# crosswork_file_servers (Resource)

This resource can manage the file servers of the cluster.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "crosswork_file_servers" "example" {
  ftp_enabled         = true
  sftp_upload_enabled = true
  tftp_enabled        = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `ftp_enabled` (Boolean) Enable the FTP server
  - Default value: `false`
- `instance` (String) Select an instance of the provider configuration by its name. Leave it unset to use the default instance.
- `sftp_upload_enabled` (Boolean) Enable the SFTP server upload
  - Default value: `false`
- `tftp_enabled` (Boolean) Enable the TFTP server
  - Default value: `false`

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The id of the object

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import crosswork_file_servers.example "file_servers"
```
